**Finding: deviation (medium) — Section 11.1 Term**

The renewal mechanics are largely acceptable from our side: 1-year automatic renewals with a mutual 30-day non-renewal notice (well inside the preferred ≤30-day window, no multi-year auto-renewal, so no walk-away issue).

Two preferred elements are absent:
- No obligation on Commerce One to remind us 60 days before a renewal.
- No cap on renewal pricing — Exhibit B only says "Year 2-5, and beyond: [*]" for maintenance/support and MarketSite fees, leaving renewal-term uplift unconstrained.

Redline (validated, ok:true) adds to 11.1 a 60-day renewal reminder from Commerce One and caps renewal fees at the lesser of CPI and 3% over the prior term, with a 5% fallback flagged in the comment.
